lines.spoken: Just before eleven at night, your manager texts the night crew. Storm's early. Lock up behind the last customer.
lines.caption: Just before **eleven**... Storm's **early**.

lines.spoken: Three of you are working tonight. You. Dana, who has the keys. And Marcus, who drives the forklift.
lines.caption: Three of you. Dana, the **keys**. Marcus, the **forklift**.

lines.spoken: The forecast says a foot and a half of snow by morning. The roads close at midnight.
lines.caption: A foot and a half by **morning**.

lines.spoken: Nobody's worried. The store has enough water to fill a swimming pool. Worst case, you sleep in the bedding aisle.
lines.caption: Enough water to fill a **swimming pool**.

lines.spoken: At two in the morning, you're restocking aisle fourteen when the lights flicker.
lines.caption: The lights **flicker**.

lines.spoken: The generator kicks in. Only half the lights come back.
lines.caption: Only **half** come back.

lines.spoken: By four, the wind has piled snow against the front doors. Dana pushes. They open two inches and stop.
lines.caption: Two inches. Then they **stop**.

lines.spoken: Marcus checks the loading dock. The bay camera shows nothing but white. Snow, packed against the lens, eight feet up.
lines.caption: Nothing but **white**. **Eight feet** up.

lines.spoken: Your phone has one bar. The county alert says plows are suspended. Stay where you are.
lines.caption: Plows **suspended**.

lines.spoken: Dana does the math out loud. The generator has fuel for three days. And every freezer in the store is already starting to drip.
lines.caption: Fuel for **three days**. Already **dripping**.

lines.spoken: Then she pulls up the cameras to check the other doors.
lines.caption: The **cameras**.

lines.spoken: Camera six. Aisle twenty-two. Pet food.
lines.caption: Camera 6. Aisle 22. **Pet food**.

lines.spoken: Someone is sitting on the floor, eating out of a bag.
lines.caption: Someone is **sitting** there.

lines.spoken: Dana locked the doors at eleven. Nobody came in after that.
lines.caption: Nobody came **in**.

lines.spoken: Which means they were already inside.
lines.caption: Already **inside**.
